topics.title: Heritage Venue Sourcing, Capacity Audits & Permitting
topics.objective: Evaluate destination palace/resort inventory, heritage heritage acoustics, and local municipality noise permits.
topics.example: VenueScorecard: { guest_capacity: 400, heritage_status: 'Grade I', curfew_hour: '22:00', rooms_blocked: 120 }
topics.exercise: Construct a multi-venue comparative evaluation matrix scoring lakeside palaces on guest logistics and sound curfews.

topics.title: Guest Travel Logistics, Room Blocking & Arrival Concierge
topics.objective: Coordinate chartered flight manifests, airport transit fleets, and tiered luxury accommodation room blocks.
topics.example: ArrivalManifest: { flight_num: '6E-442', arrival: '14:20', guests: 24, assigned_fleet: 'Volvo Coach 2' }
topics.exercise: Build an arrival schedule dashboard tracking real-time flight delays and automated bus fleet dispatch.

topics.title: Multi-Day Cultural Itinerary & Themed Event Production
topics.objective: Schedule sequential ceremonial events (Mehendi, Sangeet, Pheras, Reception) with zero vendor overlap.
topics.example: Day 1: Welcome High Tea (Poolside) -> Day 2: Sangeet (Courtyard) -> Day 3: Royal Pheras (Lakeside)
topics.exercise: Draft a minute-by-minute run-sheet for a 500-guest Royal Sangeet night including artist soundchecks and stage transitions.

topics.title: Catering Curation, Floral Décor & Audio-Visual Rigging
topics.objective: Manage regional culinary stations, temperature-sensitive floral supply chains, and outdoor truss rigging safety.
topics.example: MenuArchitecture: Traditional Gujarati Thali lunch + Live Mediterranean mezze counters for Sangeet.
topics.exercise: Design a cold-chain transit schedule for imported floral installations arriving 48 hours prior to the main ceremony.

topics.title: Emergency Weather Contingencies & Plan-B Relocation
topics.objective: Establish rapid weather diversion plans for outdoor lakefront ceremonies with covered hall relocations.
topics.exercise: Author an operational Plan-B relocation protocol transitioning an outdoor lakeside setup indoors within 4 hours.
